name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: Centered modal with overlay, title, description and a built-in close control.
docs: Bind with v-model:open. The panel sets role dialog with modal behaviour, locks background scroll and traps Tab inside. Escape and outside clicks close it unless closeOnEsc or closeOnOutside are false. Always render DialogTitle; it becomes the accessible name. Set hideClose on DialogContent when the panel supplies its own dismiss control.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Dialog as DialogRoot } from '@ui-sdk/vue/dialog'
import { provideDialogBehaviour } from './behaviour'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type DialogProps = {
  /** Initial open state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  /** Closes when the pointer goes down outside the panel. */
  closeOnOutside?: boolean
  closeOnEsc?: boolean
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<DialogProps>(), {
  defaultOpen: undefined,
  closeOnOutside: true,
  closeOnEsc: true,
})

const onOpenChange = provideDialogBehaviour({
  closeOnOutside: () => props.closeOnOutside,
  closeOnEsc: () => props.closeOnEsc,
})

const open = defineModel<boolean>('open')
</script>

<template>
  <DialogRoot
    v-model:open="open"
    :default-open="defaultOpen"
    modal
    v-bind="$attrs"
    @open-change="onOpenChange"
  >
    <slot />
  </DialogRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { DialogTrigger as SdkDialogTrigger } from '@ui-sdk/vue/dialog'
import { RenderChild } from '@/lib/render-child'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type DialogTriggerProps = {
  as?: string | object
  asChild?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<DialogTriggerProps>(), {
  as: 'button',
  asChild: false,
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkDialogTrigger v-bind="$attrs" :class="!asChild && 'h-auto border-0 bg-transparent p-0'">
    <template #render="{ props: part }">
      <RenderChild v-if="asChild" v-bind="part"><slot /></RenderChild>
      <component :is="as" v-else v-bind="part"><slot /></component>
    </template>
  </SdkDialogTrigger>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { DialogTitle as SdkDialogTitle } from '@ui-sdk/vue/dialog'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkDialogTitle
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('text-[17px] font-medium text-ink', attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  >
    <slot />
  </SdkDialogTitle>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { DialogDescription as SdkDialogDescription } from '@ui-sdk/vue/dialog'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkDialogDescription
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('mt-2 text-[14px] text-ink-muted', attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  >
    <slot />
  </SdkDialogDescription>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { DialogClose as SdkDialogClose } from '@ui-sdk/vue/dialog'
import { RenderChild } from '@/lib/render-child'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type DialogCloseProps = {
  as?: string | object
  asChild?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<DialogCloseProps>(), {
  as: 'button',
  asChild: false,
})
</script>

<template>
  <SdkDialogClose v-bind="$attrs" :class="!asChild && 'h-auto border-0 bg-transparent p-0'">
    <template #render="{ props: part }">
      <RenderChild v-if="asChild" v-bind="part"><slot /></RenderChild>
      <component :is="as" v-else v-bind="part"><slot /></component>
    </template>
  </SdkDialogClose>
</template>

/**
 * The dialog close control mirrors the ghost button: transparent until hovered,
 * ink icon, 2px focus ring at 2px offset.
 */
export const closeButton = [
  'absolute right-4 top-4 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] border-0 bg-transparent p-0',
  'text-[16px] leading-none text-ink-muted',
  'hover:bg-control hover:text-ink active:scale-95 motion-reduce:active:scale-100',
  'outline-none focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ink',
  'transition-[background-color,color,transform] duration-[var(--p0seid0n-duration-fast)] ease-spring motion-reduce:transition-none',
].join(' ')

export { default as Dialog } from './Dialog.vue'
export { default as DialogTrigger } from './DialogTrigger.vue'
export { default as DialogContent } from './DialogContent.vue'
export { default as DialogTitle } from './DialogTitle.vue'
export { default as DialogDescription } from './DialogDescription.vue'
export { default as DialogClose } from './DialogClose.vue'

export type { DialogProps } from './Dialog.vue'
export type { DialogTriggerProps } from './DialogTrigger.vue'
export type { DialogContentProps } from './DialogContent.vue'
export type { DialogCloseProps } from './DialogClose.vue'
